text.p: Electroglas Inc, a leading manufacturer of semiconductor wafer probing systems, said it expects third quarter revenues to range between $29 and $31 million and net income from $0.15 to $0.18 a share.
Analysts expected the company to earn $0.31 a share in the third quarter, according to First Call, a research firm.
"The supply/demand imbalance in the semiconductor industry has impacted our customers' near term capacity plans and capital equipment orders," Curt Wozniak, chief executive said.
Wozniak said order rates from around the world are lower than expected and backlog has been reduced.
Electroglas has reduced spending and head count and will continue to cut spending to suit its business environment, it said.
It added, however, it will continuing to aggressively invest in new product development and customer support to insure its presence in emerging markets.
